headline: Victoria Man Free-Climbs Rock Chimney to Save Injured Hang Glider
meta_description: A Victoria resident scaled a 27-foot rock chimney without gear to reach and help an injured hang glider trapped in a mountain gully.
summary_short: A Victoria man used his climbing skills to reach an injured hang glider suspended in a remote mountain gully, freeing him and staying until rescue arrived.
body:
A Victoria man free-climbed a 27-foot rock chimney without any climbing gear to reach an injured hang glider who was suspended in a mountain gully. Once he reached the stranded flyer, he freed him from his harness and remained with him until professional rescuers arrived.

The rescue demonstrated both exceptional nerve and practical problem-solving. The climber faced the challenge of ascending a steep rock formation with no equipment—relying only on his climbing knowledge and physical ability to navigate the narrow chimney. Upon reaching the hang glider, he didn't simply alert authorities and descend; instead, he took action to free the injured person from the harness restraining him.

The presence of a calm, capable person likely made a critical difference for the injured pilot during those anxious moments in the gully. By staying at the scene until help arrived, the Victoria climber ensured the hang glider wasn't alone and could receive immediate assistance from rescue teams.
quick_facts: 27-foot rock chimney climbed without any gear
Hang glider trapped in a mountain gully
Rescuer from Victoria freed the injured pilot from his harness
Climber remained with the injured person until rescue arrived
